prompt: Which safely sums all numeric command-line arguments, skipping non-numeric ones?
choices: int sum = 0; for (String a : args) sum += Integer.parseInt(a);
int sum = 0; for (String a : args) { try { sum += Integer.parseInt(a); } catch (NumberFormatException e) {} }
explanation: Wrapping parseInt in try-catch skips non-numeric tokens gracefully. Option A crashes on any non-numeric argument. Option C: arrays don't have a sum() method on String[]. Option D: joining all args into one string produces a concat, not a sum.
